chunks: And I swear by Allah with a true oath,
if it reaches me that you have been dishonest with a small or large portion of the spoils (fay') of the Muslims,
I will surely inflict upon you a severe punishment that will leave you with little strength, heavy-backed, and diminished in authority;

key_terms.فَيْءُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ: Spoils of war or public funds of the Muslims

ai.seo_question: What is the consequence of misappropriating the Muslim treasury according to this letter?
ai.summary: This letter, part of Imam Ali’s administrative correspondence, underscores the principle of strict accountability in public finance, reflecting the Shia emphasis on justice (Adl) and the integrity of the ruler. The vivid imagery of being 'burdened' and 'stripped of authority' serves as both a warning against corruption and a reminder that leadership is a trust (amanah) accountable to God and the community.
